description: Denial and error are first-class, contracted outcomes. A consumer receives a structured denial or error in response to a request. Field values below are placeholders for illustration only.

response.reason: The request is not permitted under the consumer's agreed contract scope.
The request did not conform to the agreed contract shape.
The request could not be resolved unambiguously and was denied by default.

notes: outcome is one of: denied | error.
reason_code is a stable, machine-readable identifier; reason is a human-readable explanation.
Default discipline is fail-closed: silence is non-authorization, and ambiguity resolves to denied.
A denial or error is a complete, contracted response — not an exception to the contract.
